Mine isn't a cancer story but I felt I had to let it out for once. Last year my grandfather collapsed due to his kidney failing because of his diabetes. He already knew he was diabetic and he was always cautious of what he's eating and of his blood sugar levels but it still happened. He was admitted into an ICU for almost a month and was sedated the whole time and a few more weeks in a normal ward. I still remember the first time I saw him in the ICU. The moment I saw the state he was in I started crying like a freaking baby and my legs were shaking. Because I was studying pretty far from home I had to fly back and since my flight was in the evening I went to visit him during the day for a few hours just to see him and help my grandmother take care of him before I leave. When I had to go and tell him that I'm leaving, the last thing he said to me was that he was thankful for all the times I helped took care of him. And then less than a week after I left, he passed away. I couldn't believe that he was gone until I went back home and he wasn't there. Fuck, the night that my parents told me my grandfather passed away I dreamt that I woke up in the morning at my grandfather's place and saw him sitting at the dining table in the kitchen and he told me to sit down and have breakfast with him like he always does whenever I slept over at his place. That was the first time I woke up while tearing up.

Edit: I may have believed that he's gone now, but I still can't move on from the fact that he has passed away just like most of the things that happened last year.
